title: VLM in a flash: I/O-Efficient Sparsification of Vision-Language Model via NEURON CHUNKING

experiment_framework: Jetson Orin Nano/AGX设备，LLaVA-OneVision等模型，TempCompass等数据集，对比top-k基线

连续访问模式对闪存性能的关键影响
